scoped_implementation: Server request UUID correlation and restricted JSON response/status/handler-duration signals available. No raw request/headers/payload/URL-path/exception logging in new stream. Existing business/authorization/support-audit authority unchanged.
failure_handling: Ordinary logging failure keeps response and records sanitized telemetry.delivery_failed to stderr; if fallback also unavailable, delivery flags only. This is no delivery durability/readiness proof.
limitations: No selected external telemetry sink/retention/alert routing or named owners
No approved critical-domain operational signal/alert acceptance catalog; HTTP outcomes are not transaction audit/financial posting/settlement facts
Duration is handler response creation time, not full streaming delivery; no performance/stream-runtime certification
Existing support request/confirm/independent approve/use/expiry/revoke/audit code unchanged, not reimplemented or production-qualified
No process/deployment readiness endpoint or external activation

ac.semantics: Production-certification criteria UNVERIFIED; foundation tests not certification
